what: crates/hir-expand/src/inert_attr_macro.rs lists `no_sanitize` (line ~237) but not `sanitize`, the built-in that replaced it in rustc (feature `sanitize`, on the pinned nightly-2026-10-27). So `#[sanitize(address = "off")]` resolves as a macro and fails (`unresolved macro sanitize`, 11 lines in fuzz/src/raw.rs in check22). hir-def attrs already know it (AttrFlags::HAS_SANITIZE) and blaze-diagnostics parses it. Add `sanitize` as a Normal gated (experimental!(sanitize)) inert attribute, as rustc builtin_attrs.rs has it.
